description: This file defines the ShutdownBehaviour class responsible for handling shutdown commands within an Akka actor system, including subscribing to pub-sub topics and executing shutdown logic based on command reasons.

classes.name: ShutdownBehaviour
classes.description: Handles actor shutdown logic based on received shutdown commands, manages pub-sub subscriptions, and creates message receive handlers.

methods.name: fromId
methods.description: Creates a ShutdownBehaviour instance from an entity ID with namespace, subscribing to pub-sub.

methods.name: fromIdWithoutNamespace
methods.description: Creates a ShutdownBehaviour instance from an entity ID without namespace, subscribing to pub-sub.

methods.name: fromIdWithNamespace
methods.description: Internal method to instantiate ShutdownBehaviour with explicit namespace, ensuring pub-sub subscription.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Builds the message handler for the actor, matching Shutdown commands and pub-sub acknowledgments.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Executes shutdown if the reason is relevant for the namespace or entity ID.
